    • getEventClass

      @Nullable public @Nullable java.lang.Class<? extends Event> getEventClass()
      获取此监听器处理的事件类. 如果处理了多个事件类, 将返回最近的共享超类, 使得对于此监听器处理的任何事件, this.getEventClass().isAssignableFrom(event.getClass()) 成立, 并且不存在 this.getEventClass().isAssignableFrom(clazz) && this.getEventClass() != clazz && event.getClass().isAssignableFrom(clazz) 的类.

      原文： Gets the class of the events this listener handled. If it handled multiple classes of event, the closest shared superclass will be returned, such that for any event this listener has handled, this.getEventClass().isAssignableFrom(event.getClass()) and no class this.getEventClass().isAssignableFrom(clazz) && this.getEventClass() != clazz && event.getClass().isAssignableFrom(clazz) for all handled events.

      返回:
      此 RegisteredListener 处理的事件类

      原文：the event class handled by this RegisteredListener

      public boolean hasMultiple()
      获取此监听器是否处理了多个事件, 即存在两个事件使得 eventA.getClass() != eventB.getClass().

      原文： Gets whether this listener has handled multiple events, such that for some two events, eventA.getClass() != eventB.getClass().

      返回:
      如果此监听器处理了多个事件则返回 true
